native_checkpoint.source_status: Author-passed 31 C1 tests and 24 Gherkin scenarios / 73 steps are bound to this exact source checkpoint. Risk independently read both genuine failures, the corrected source delta and final layout run, with no additional bounded behavior blocker. Overall integration, architecture/lint/format checks and publication remain HOLD; finite model checking does not prove the native classifier.

native_input_contract: RiskDue means the actual mandatory minute+1ms turn has admitted its required context and found a supported known-state risk close. It does not mean every loss is guaranteed to be closable.
Pending means ANY retained funding boundary whose receipt is absent, including a boundary with zero captured quantity. Paid means no unpaid entry remains, not deletion of historical identities.
Settled means actual zero inventory plus authoritative complete cuts, not a bare canceled flag or the absence of an order object.
BeforeE/AtE/AfterE are trusted native classifications of actual observation receipt knowledge. A still-unpublished row is not an admitted economic payload.
economicBeforeE and sourceBeforeE classify actual physical fills and used keys. This model does not prove the i64 arithmetic, source factory, manifest identity or the classifier itself.
